global: pizzicato strings, bouncy synth bass, glockenspiel, brass stabs, timpani, light drums

sections.name: hook
sections.style: big triumphant cartoon brass fanfare with timpani, a heavy clank hit, cheeky and amazed

sections.name: launch
sections.style: dusky anticipation: low strings pulsing, a countdown tick, then a huge rising orchestral swell and rumbling liftoff

sections.name: orbit
sections.style: floaty and fast: twinkly glockenspiel and synth arpeggios whirling around, light and wondrous

sections.name: return
sections.style: tense descent: tremolo strings, a whoosh, three rising stabs building suspense

sections.name: catch
sections.style: a clamp hit then a joyful celebration: brass and drums, cheering energy, bright and bouncy

sections.name: twist
sections.style: deadpan comic: sneaky pizzicato bassoon, slowing down, a deflating trombone, ends on a cartoon boom

sections.name: ending
sections.style: warm playful outro, bouncy pizzicato and glockenspiel melody, cheeky button ending
